title: Assignment Topics: Consensus, Multi-Agent Systems, Search, P2P, MapReduce
src: Source: Assignment 01 Parts A and C and the Lecture 01 module outline. There are no lecture slides for these topics; written from standard textbooks.
lead: Not in the lecture slides: topics from Assignment 01 and the module outline. 2PC weaknesses and consensus (Paxos, Raft, why consensus is harder), multi-agent systems (characteristics, FIPA-ACL, Contract Net, conflict resolution), distributed search (inverted index, sharding, PageRank), P2P (Gnutella flooding, Chord and Kademlia DHTs, BitTorrent), MapReduce and cloud programming models, ACID vs BASE.
